units: <cite ref="Mishnah Nedarim 2:3">Ned. II, 3</cite> <he>יש נ׳ בתוך נ׳</he> there is a vow within a vow, i.e. if one repeats the vow to be a Nazarite, it is a double vow.
<cite ref="Nedarim 8a:5">Ib. 8ᵃ</cite> <he>נ׳ גדול נָדַר וכ׳</he> (by saying so) he has made a great vow to the God of Israel; a. v. fr.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 2:7:3">Y. Sabb. II, 5ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>הותר הנ׳</he> the vow is annulled, i.e. the ban is rescinded.—Pl. <he>נְדָרִים</he>, constr. <he>נִדְרֵי</he>.

Ib. III, 1 ארבע נ׳ וכ׳ four sorts of vows have the scholars declared not to be binding; נדרי זרוזין וכ׳, v. זֵירוּז, הֲבַאי &c. Ib. XI, 1, a. fr. נדרי עינוי נפש vows referring to privation of the necessaries of life; a. fr.—N’darim, name of a treatise, of the Order of Nashim, of Mishnah, Tosefta, Talmud Babli a. Y’rushalmi.
